messages.subject: RE: Draft grievance outcome — your eyes before it goes
messages.plaintextBody:
Miriam,

The balance is right. Upholding the consultation point is fine and honest — it's a process failing, not an admission on causation. On the detriment point, keep the language as "I do not find you were subjected to detriment" and note that the concerns were properly escalated to Audit Committee and auditors. Avoid saying the concerns were "unfounded" — we don't want to look like we dismissed a disclosure. I've made a couple of tracked tweaks; go ahead and send tomorrow.

Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield
